what: The proposed allowlist regex conflicts with the stated positive-round/no-leading-zero constraint
scenario_or_breakage: The plan specifies ^round-[0-9]+/findings-classification\.tsv$, which allows round-0 and round-001 even though the prose says positive integer rounds with no leading zero
suggested_fix: Use an anchored regex such as ^round-[1-9][0-9]*/findings-classification\.tsv$ in both implementation and docs, and add harness cases for round-0 and round-01 rejection

what: The TSV sanitization command contradicts the required tab replacement semantics
scenario_or_breakage: The plan says tabs become single spaces, but the proposed tr -d '\t' deletes tabs, which can concatenate voter-sourced/reviewer-sourced fields and produce different TSV cell content than the acceptance criterion expects
suggested_fix: Replace tabs with spaces, for example tr '\t' ' ' | tr '\n' ' ', and keep the harness assertion aligned with replacement rather than deletion

what: The parser implementation contract asks awk to emit via the Bash emit_kv helper from its END block
scenario_or_breakage: awk cannot call the sourced shell function emit_kv; with lib-quiet enabled, plain awk stdout would go to the quiet log unless routed deliberately, so the described implementation can silently fail to produce PARSED_* KVs
suggested_fix: Revise the plan so awk returns parsed fields to the Bash wrapper and the wrapper calls emit_kv, or explicitly document direct awk writes to /dev/fd/3 instead of claiming emit_kv is called from awk
